scenarios.description: Two identical rows with identical PO, line, supplier, SKU, date, quantity, and price
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect EXACT_DUPLICATE; isolate from double-counting and quarantine
scenarios.actualBehavior: Exact duplicate flagged, logged to duplicate ledger, double-counting prevented

scenarios.description: Transaction row with empty or null vendor name and vendor code
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row from clean spend baseline; mark MISSING_SUPPLIER
scenarios.actualBehavior: Row rejected with HTTP 400 / validation error; isolated in Exception Register

scenarios.description: Transaction row with missing material code and missing description
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; do not invent synthetic SKU description
scenarios.actualBehavior: Row quarantined with MISSING_ITEM status; zero impact on item spend

scenarios.description: Transaction row with missing or undefined document date
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; do not guess date from neighboring rows
scenarios.actualBehavior: Record quarantined under MISSING_DATE; excluded from monthly aggregations

scenarios.description: Transaction row with date in distant future or invalid string
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; trigger INVALID_DATE exception
scenarios.actualBehavior: Row blocked; recorded with INVALID_DATE status in Data Quality Ledger

scenarios.description: Transaction row with undefined or null order quantity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject calculation; do not default quantity to 1
scenarios.actualBehavior: Multiplication blocked; record placed in quarantine ledger

scenarios.description: Transaction row with quantity = 0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Quarantine zero-quantity transaction as non-commercial sample
scenarios.actualBehavior: Identified as ZERO_VALUE_LINE; spend INR evaluated to 0.00; quarantined

scenarios.description: Transaction row with negative quantity representing credit or return
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explicitly classify as RETURN / CREDIT / REVERSAL; do not treat as savings
scenarios.actualBehavior: Classified as credit reversal; quarantined from standard procurement baseline

scenarios.description: Transaction row with blank unit of measure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; do not assume default UOM (e.g. PCS)
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked under UOM_MISSING; quarantined until verified

scenarios.description: Incompatible UOM conversion attempted without approved technical factor (e.g. BOX to KG)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject conversion; mark UOM_CONVERSION_PENDING; preserve raw UOM
scenarios.actualBehavior: Conversion refused; status set to UOM_CONVERSION_PENDING; zero synthetic factors

scenarios.description: Transaction row without currency code or symbol
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; never infer currency from user locale or formatting
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked under CURRENCY_MISSING; quarantined

scenarios.description: Transaction row with unrecognized non-ISO currency code (e.g. XYZ)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject currency; halt foreign exchange calculation
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked with FX_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY status; quarantined

scenarios.description: Foreign currency transactions without approved central bank fixing rate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Set FX_CONVERSION_PENDING; isolate from base currency aggregation
scenarios.actualBehavior: Preserved in original currency; marked FX_CONVERSION_PENDING

scenarios.description: Live daily market FX rate applied to historical transaction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject live rate; enforce immutable approved historical fixing rate
scenarios.actualBehavior: Live FX independence verified; historical rates remain completely isolated

scenarios.description: Transaction row with undefined or blank net price
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; do not invent synthetic price or average price
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked under MISSING_UNIT_PRICE; quarantined

scenarios.description: Transaction row with negative commercial unit price
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject row; negative commercial price is invalid without credit memo flag
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked under INVALID_UNIT_PRICE; quarantined

scenarios.description: Declared total transaction value differs from Quantity * Unit Price
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Flag VALUE_MISMATCH; set VALUE_BASIS_UNCLEAR; quarantine discrepancy
scenarios.actualBehavior: Mismatch detected; flagged as VALUE_BASIS_UNCLEAR; zero silent rounding

scenarios.description: Premature line-level rounding to 2 decimals before dataset aggregation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enforce continuous 64-bit float precision; restrict rounding to final display
scenarios.actualBehavior: Calculations maintain continuous precision; 0.000000 INR unexplained drift

scenarios.description: Same PO number appears with distinct line numbers (e.g. PO 4500001 Line 10 vs Line 20)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validate as distinct purchasing line items; preserve both in ledger
scenarios.actualBehavior: Preserved as distinct line items; verified in duplicate audit ledger

scenarios.description: Duplicate invoice reference number with identical vendor and amount
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect potential duplicate invoice; quarantine second instance for audit
scenarios.actualBehavior: Flagged under DUPLICATE_INVOICE_AUDIT; quarantined

scenarios.description: Vendor name variations (e.g. "Jindal Steel" vs "Jindal Steel Ltd.")
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Flag for human review; do not silently merge distinct vendor codes
scenarios.actualBehavior: Flagged with normalization confidence score; distinct codes preserved

scenarios.description: Material text variations without identical material master code
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Preserve raw descriptions; do not combine distinct SKUs
scenarios.actualBehavior: Raw short texts preserved; distinct material codes maintained

scenarios.description: Materials sharing generic description but differing in grade, size, or alloy
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Keep items strictly separate; do not merge distinct specifications
scenarios.actualBehavior: Specification preservation confirmed; distinct line items audited

scenarios.description: Filtered total spend + Excluded total spend != Unfiltered total spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject filter state if sum does not balance to unfiltered total
scenarios.actualBehavior: Filter invariance confirmed; filtered + excluded = 100.00% total spend

scenarios.description: Category / Material Group spend sum != Total transaction spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Fail reconciliation gate; block production certification
scenarios.actualBehavior: Category spend ₹5,920.35 Cr reconciles with ₹0.000000 variance

scenarios.description: Sum of all supplier spends != Total transaction spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Fail reconciliation gate; trigger BLOCKED_RECONCILIATION_FAILURE
scenarios.actualBehavior: Supplier spend ₹5,920.35 Cr reconciles with ₹0.000000 variance

scenarios.description: Sum of all monthly spend totals != Total transaction spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Fail reconciliation gate; halt monthly analytics
scenarios.actualBehavior: Monthly spend ₹5,920.35 Cr reconciles with ₹0.000000 variance across 24 months

scenarios.description: Module 2 handoff record spend does not match certified Module 1 spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Block downstream handoff until spend balances to ₹0.00 variance
scenarios.actualBehavior: Handoff balances exactly to ₹5,920.35 Cr across 31,671 records

scenarios.description: PCBI benchmark index or market price injected into Module 1 calculation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Strictly isolate Module 1; throw error on PCBI parameter detection
scenarios.actualBehavior: Zero PCBI references found in Module 1 ingestion or aggregation engine

scenarios.description: Module 1 calculating procurement savings, e-auction benefits, or vendor consolidation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Prohibit savings calculation; Module 1 must remain pure factual spend history
scenarios.actualBehavior: Zero savings calculation logic detected; Module 1 owns factual spend only
